'''''Arenaria montana''''', the '''mountain sandwort''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17}}</ref> is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Caryophyllaceae]], [[native plant|native]] to mountainous regions of southwestern Europe, from the Pyrenees to Portugal.<ref name="CU">{{cite web
|url= https://www.entomology.cornell.edu/Extension/Woodys/CUGroundCoverSite/Arenaria%20montana.html
|title= CU Allstar Groundcovers! - ''Arenaria montana''
|accessdate= 2008-04-30
|publisher= Cornell University
| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20080423061740/http://www.entomology.cornell.edu/Extension/Woodys/CUGroundCoverSite/Arenaria%20montana.html| archivedate= 23 April 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref> The Latin [[Botanical name#Binary name|specific epithet]] ''montana'' refers to mountains or coming from mountains.<ref>Archibald William Smith {{google books|ahNMkgoNJ7IC|A Gardener's Handbook of Plant Names: Their Meanings and Origins|page=239}}</ref>
[[File:Arenaria Montana in bloom.jpg|thumb|280px|Arenaria Montana in bloom]]

==Description==
''Arenaria montana'' is an [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] growing {{convert|14|-|22|cm|0|abbr=on}} tall, with [[Leaf shape|lanceolate]] or [[Leaf shape|ovate]] green to grayish-green [[Phyllotaxis|opposite]] [[Leaf|leaves]] {{convert|10|-|30|mm|1|abbr=on}} in length.

From mid to late Spring it produces dense clumps of white to near-white [[flower]]s approximately {{convert|25|mm|0|abbr=on}} in diameter borne on [[Inflorescence#Organization|cymes]] of 2 to 10 flowers each.<ref name="WGF">
{{cite web
|url= http://www.wildgingerfarm.com/Arenaria.htm
|title= Arenaria
|accessdate= 2008-04-30
|publisher= Wild Ginger Farm (c)
|archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20080509123448/http://www.wildgingerfarm.com/Arenaria.htm
|archivedate= 9 May 2008
|url-status= dead
}}
</ref><ref name="BYG">{{cite web
|url= http://www.backyardgardener.com/plantname/pd_d250.html
|title= ''Arenaria montana'' (Sandwort)
|accessdate= 2008-04-30
|publisher= BackyardGardener.com
| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20080513214536/http://www.backyardgardener.com/plantname/pd_d250.html| archivedate= 13 May 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref name="CU" />

''Arenaria montana'' prefers well drained, sandy to sandy [[loam]] [[soil]]s, of moderate ([[pH]] 5.5 to 7.5) acidity. It also prefers moist soils, as its shallow root system leaves it vulnerable to drought.<ref name="CU" /><ref name="BYG" />

This plant has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Arenaria montana''|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/27019/Arenaria-montana/Details | accessdate=23 February 2020}}</ref>
